channel.description: Latest articles from Women's Wear Daily (wwd.com)

item.title: Why Influencer Brands Are Taking Over Beauty Again
item.description: A decade after influencer brands first made their mark on beauty, a new generation of creator-founders are entering the spotlight. This time, the stakes are higher.

item.title: La Ligne, Lily Aldridge Collaborate on Capsule Celebrating 10th Anniversary and International Women’s Day
item.description: Aldridge appeared in La Ligne's first campaign at its 2016 launch.

item.title: The Indie Beauty Brands That Won Social Media in January
item.description: Jennifer Aniston's LolaVie, which debuted a new hair growth serum, saw the most media impact value growth during the period.

item.title: The Tory Burch Foundation’s Second Annual Founders Breakfast Will Honor Anna Wintour
item.description: The breakfast will also spotlight outstanding women entrepreneurs from the Fellows Program, which has provided $2 million in grants to more than 380 women.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: This New Fashion M&A Firm Boasts an Astonishing Rolodex
item.description: Mallevays Fleurieu was recently founded in Paris by the former M&A heads of LVMH Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton and Kering.

item.title: Lauryn Bosstick Gives the Skinny on Launching Her Wellness Empire
item.description: The Skinny Confidential wellness entrepreneur chats with WWD on the Beauty of Tomorrow podcast about the evolution of her brand, the inside story of her viral ice roller and more.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Mother Plays Ball in Paris With Merci Pop-up
item.description: The L.A.-based denim brand will turn the Marais concept store into an immersive athletic universe for the month.

item.title: Olivier Saillard Breathes Life Into Fashion With Cartier Foundation Residency
item.description: As part of his "Living Museum of Fashion" project, the historian will stage live presentations and performances with Tilda Swinton and Paloma Picasso.

item.title: Paloma Picasso on Vintage Fashion, Helmut Newton and the Power of a Red Lip
item.description: The jewelry designer will join fashion historian Olivier Saillard on stage in Paris to discuss how she inspired Yves Saint Laurent’s Scandal Collection in 1971.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Julia Garner Is Now a Global Brand Ambassador for Loewe
item.description: The American actress, perhaps best know for "Ozark" and "Inventing Anna," was previously affiliated with Gucci.
